purpose: Machine-readable guide for external LLMs that draft OpenVisionLab VisionPipeline XML.

productIdentity.name: OpenVisionLab
productIdentity.scope: OpenCvSharp4 rule-based vision recipe workbench with LLM-assisted XML generation and validation.

inspectionIntentSkills.name: Dark band thickness / Gap (LineDistance)
inspectionIntentSkills.status: Phase 1 contract frozen; P190 all-500 replay closed as Keep with documented limits
requiredOperatorInputs: exactly one reviewed coarse ROI containing the intended long dark band
inspectionIntentSkills.judgementBoundary: measurement-only until operator tolerance and calibration evidence exist
inspectionIntentSkills.semanticSelectionRule: The magenta lower edge must be the nearest sustained bright transition after the dark core immediately below the selected upper edge; a farther Hough edge is not the same-band boundary.

globalRules: Return only VisionPipeline XML when XML is requested.
InputLayer must be Main or a previous enabled Step OutputLayer.
Use ALLOW_BRANCH_INPUT=true for intentional fan-out from an earlier layer.
Prefer unique OutputLayer values so source images and evidence layers are preserved.
Do not emit Inspection.* XML nodes or parameters.
Do not invent dependency paths; use existing paths only.
SCORE_MIN, GREEDINESS, and HYBRID_VERIFY_IMAGE_WEIGHT are 0..1 decimals.
Threshold, MaxValue, RangeMin, RangeMax, CANNY_LOW, and CANNY_HIGH are 0..255 gray values.
HSV HueMin and HueMax use OpenCV's 0..179 scale. HueMin may exceed HueMax to wrap through the 179/0 boundary; Saturation and Value values are 0..255 and their minimum must not exceed maximum.
Kernel sizes and counts must be positive; odd-only kernels must be odd.
FIND_ANGLE_MIN must be less than or equal to FIND_ANGLE_MAX.

Every fixture workflow requires one earlier reviewed producer: Matching with NUM_MATCH=1, or LineFixture with two exact earlier accepted Line Segment references. The LLM must not invent either physical identity.
TranslationRoi fixture v1 requires the same source layer, one enabled CvROI, USE_FIXTURE_FRAME=true, the same FIXTURE_FRAME_NAME, and ALLOW_BRANCH_INPUT=true; it never rotates or scales the ROI.

NormalizeImage fixture v2 requires reviewed reference image dimensions, a same-source RotateScale branch, FIXTURE_APPLY_MODE=NormalizeImage, no ROI/masks, and a positive valid-pixel gate no greater than one.
Optional fixture scale limits must be supplied together as FIXTURE_MIN_SCALE_RATIO and FIXTURE_MAX_SCALE_RATIO with 0 < minimum <= maximum.
Fixture application never rewrites saved ROIs and never silently falls back after a fixture failure.
OverlayMerge should usually be the final enabled Step when it is the operator review result.

limitations: one unambiguous Matching result or one gated dual-Line origin

fixtureSimilarityNormalizeImageV2.status: Supported for Matching pose -> full-image inverse uniform-similarity normalization. P182 qualifies one bounded C9 NormalizeImage -> LineDistance coordinate/drawing path, and P183 qualifies a C9-bounded pre-measurement score/ambiguity/pose/coverage gate on the exact observed 24-row set plus deliberate gate exercises. Broader and unseen robustness remains separate.

requiredValues.InputLayer: same unannotated source layer used by the Matching producer

limitations: one unambiguous Matching result or one gated dual-Line origin
source image dimensions must equal the taught reference dimensions
no ROI, multi-ROI, or masks on the NormalizeImage Step
pixel-coordinate normalization only; no calibration or perspective claim
do not claim a downstream measurement until its drawing is verified on DeviceAligned

requiredEvidence: acceptance metrics when OK/NG judgement is needed

tools.role: Create a binary or range-thresholded layer from an input image.
validationHints: Threshold, MaxValue, RangeMin, and RangeMax must be 0..255.
Typical OutputLayer: Binary_Result or Threshold_Result.

tools.role: Clean binary regions with morphological operations.
validationHints: KernelWidth, KernelHeight, and Iterations must be positive.
Use after Threshold when blobs or contours need noise cleanup.

tools.role: Apply image filtering before inspection.
validationHints: KernelWidth and KernelHeight must be positive for Blur, GaussianBlur, and BoxFilter.
MedianBlur requires an odd positive MedianKernelSize such as 3, 5, or 7.
BilateralFilter uses positive Diameter, SigmaColor, and SigmaSpace values.

tools.role: Create an edge image for downstream measurement or review.
validationHints: Canny thresholds must be 0..255.
CannyThresholdLow must be less than or equal to CannyThresholdHigh.

tools.role: Detect connected bright/dark regions and measure area/count/position.
validationHints: MIN_AREA must be less than or equal to MAX_AREA.
MIN_WIDTH/MAX_WIDTH and MIN_HEIGHT/MAX_HEIGHT filter each object's axis-aligned bounding box in pixels; omitted keys preserve the legacy unbounded behavior.
Disable internal threshold options when InputLayer is already a processed binary layer.

tools.role: Detect contour regions and produce shape overlays.
validationHints: Use CvROI as x,y,width,height.
MIN_AREA must be less than or equal to MAX_AREA.
MIN_WIDTH/MAX_WIDTH and MIN_HEIGHT/MAX_HEIGHT filter each object's axis-aligned bounding box in pixels; omitted keys preserve the legacy unbounded behavior.
Use ALLOW_BRANCH_INPUT=true for intentional parallel contour checks from the same prepared layer.

tools.role: Find a template in the input image.
validationHints: TemplatePath and PATTERN_PATH must point to existing files before import.
SCORE_MIN is a 0..1 decimal.
MAGNIFIATION must be positive.
FIND_ANGLE_MIN must be less than or equal to FIND_ANGLE_MAX.
FIND_SCALE_MIN, FIND_SCALE_MAX, and FIND_SCALE_STEP must be positive, and minimum must not exceed maximum.
Fixture producers require NUM_MATCH=1, a unique FIXTURE_FRAME_NAME, reviewed numeric center/angle values, and FIXTURE_REFERENCE_SCALE greater than zero.
Add positive FIXTURE_REFERENCE_IMAGE_WIDTH and FIXTURE_REFERENCE_IMAGE_HEIGHT before a NormalizeImage consumer is allowed.
When fixture scale limits are used, add both FIXTURE_MIN_SCALE_RATIO and FIXTURE_MAX_SCALE_RATIO with 0 < minimum <= maximum.
ScoreMargin is available only when NUM_MATCH=2 and means best minus second-best score in percentage points; use a separate two-candidate preflight before a NUM_MATCH=1 fixture publisher.

tools.role: Find a template using contour/edge shape when intensity matching is less reliable.
validationHints: TemplatePath and PATTERN_PATH must point to existing files before import.
SCORE_MIN, GREEDINESS, and HYBRID_VERIFY_IMAGE_WEIGHT are 0..1 decimals.
UNIQUE_MATCH_MIN_SCORE_MARGIN is a normalized 0..1 decimal.
When USE_UNIQUE_MATCH_VALIDATION=true, NUM_MATCH must be 1 and USE_MULTI_ROI must be false.
ALLOW_GLOBAL_POLARITY_REVERSAL is opt-in; a missing key preserves Same-only scoring, and true permits only one whole-candidate global direction reversal.
Unique matching returns no MatchingResult for NoMatch or Ambiguous; review UniqueMatch.State, UniqueMatch.PlausibleAlternativeCount, UniqueMatch.ScoreMargin, and the exact runtime reason.
CANNY_LOW and CANNY_HIGH are 0..255 and low must be less than or equal to high.
CANNY_APERTURE_SIZE must be odd and in the supported Canny range.

tools.role: Find a target by feature points and geometric verification.
validationHints: TemplatePath and PATTERN_PATH must point to existing files before import.
SCORE_MIN is the Lowe descriptor-ratio threshold in the 0..1 range; smaller values are stricter and it is not the final ScoreMax acceptance value.
RANSAC_REPROJ_THRESHOLD must be positive.

tools.role: Measure average brightness or channel intensity in a region.
validationHints: Use MEAN_TYPES from the supported enum.
Use MeanValueAvg or min/max mean metrics for judgement.

tools.role: Create a binary mask for one HSV color range and review color coverage.
validationHints: HueMin and HueMax are integer values in OpenCV's 0..179 hue scale.
HueMin greater than HueMax intentionally wraps through the 179/0 boundary for colors such as red.
SaturationMin must not exceed SaturationMax and ValueMin must not exceed ValueMax; both ranges are 0..255.
Keep the HSV mask in a distinct OutputLayer. A downstream Blob or Contour Step must explicitly use that mask as InputLayer.
Use MaskPixelRatio for a coverage gate and MaskPixelCount when the absolute selected area matters.

tools.role: Find line/edge features for gauge-style measurement.
validationHints: CONTRAST, THICKNESS, SAMPLING_STEP, and PIXELPERMM are numeric; PIXELPERMM must be positive.
Use line metrics for acceptance.

tools.role: Measure distance between paired edge/line projections.
validationHints: POINT_RANGE is an integer.
PIXELPERMM must be positive when mm metrics are used.

Raw edge-point intersections remain the default. Set USE_EXTEND_FIT_LINE=true only when the operator intends pairwise fitted-edge distance; both fitted intersections must remain inside the reviewed ROI, and the runtime drawing must show the ROI, both fitted edges, and final distance lines.
EXTEND_FIT_LINE_VALUE controls fit-line drawing extent. It is not a distance tolerance, calibration value, or acceptance threshold.

Do not accept pin-to-pin or edge-to-edge distance using DistancePxAvg/DistanceMmAvg alone. Add a DistancePxRange/DistanceMmRange or DistancePxMax/DistanceMmMax gate so one long outlier distance line fails.
USE_GAP_EDGE_PAIR=true is an opt-in dark-band thickness mode. It requires USE_ROI=true and one reviewed coarse CvROI; it does not use Matching or move the ROI.

Gap edge-pair drawings must show the coarse ROI, all candidate edges, selected upper/lower edges, and final distance samples. The selected lower edge must be the nearest sustained bright transition after the dark core below the selected upper edge; a farther Hough line is not an eligible substitute. Missing, weak, nonparallel, low-coverage, or ambiguous boundaries fail closed.

The P189-corrected runtime with the unchanged starter values is bounded evidence for one device_top_right small split only. Do not invent an OK/NG tolerance, millimetre calibration, or other-direction claim from it.

tools.role: Measure either adjacent edge-to-edge clearance or adjacent center-to-center pitch in one dark-pin row ROI without fixed per-pair X positions.
validationHints: CvROI must cover one pin row; PinArrayGap is not a whole-image pin detector.
MeasurementMode defaults to EdgeGap for legacy XML. EdgeGap publishes DistancePx/DistanceMm metrics; CenterPitch publishes pixel-only PitchPx metrics from adjacent detected pin centers.
Do not relabel edge clearance as pitch, publish calibrated center pitch, or enable CenterPitch through the frozen Pin Guided Setup v1.
Use DistancePxRange/DistancePxMax for EdgeGap or PitchPxRange/PitchPxMax for CenterPitch with the nominal metric; do not judge using an average alone.
Use ResultCount only after representative Good samples prove that the visible pin count is stable.
PIXELPERMM is required only when mm metrics are used.

tools.role: Measure one curved dark band by its row-wise width and outer, inner, and center arc lengths without fixed X positions.
validationHints: CvROI must contain the full intended curved dark band and enough background to keep the band separable from the left image border.
It selects the leftmost eligible dark connected component; confirm the drawn outer/inner curves before adding an acceptance gate.
CurveCenterArcLengthPx is an image-space center-path length, not a calibrated physical length until PIXELPERMM is supplied.
Use width range and center-arc metrics only after representative Good samples establish their distributions.

tools.role: Locate the visible virtual lower-right corner of one large bright object from its bottom and right outer edges, without fixed image coordinates.
validationHints: Experimental: do not select this family as a default LLM inspection-intent skill or continue image-by-image tuning.

CornerOuterContourVerified=1 proves support from the runtime-selected threshold contour only; current evidence does not prove that the fitted lower line belongs to the operator-intended physical card-bottom edge.

A hough/projection fallback is review-only. Require independent same-image ground truth for both physical edge segments and the intended intersection before any coordinate, angle, or CornerOuterContourVerified gate.
Do not use it for a general defect decision or physical-unit measurement.

tools.role: Review intersection-style line geometry.
validationHints: Use only when the recipe intent needs an intersection/gauge result.

tools.role: Fit one pixel-only circle or bounded arc from operator-taught radial calipers inside one reviewed annular sector.
validationHints: This is an operator-taught deterministic tool, not automatic circle selection from an arbitrary image.
EDGE_POLARITY is LightToDark, DarkToLight, or Either; radius values and fit gates are pixels only.
Require current-run annulus, radial support, fitted arc, center, support ratio, coverage, and residual drawings before judgement.

tools.role: Measure one explicit relationship between two named typed features produced by earlier successful Steps in the same run.
validationHints: MeasurementMode is exactly PointPointDistance, PointLineDistance, SegmentSegmentDistance, LineLineDistance, LineLineAngle, LineLineIntersection, or CircleSegmentClearance.
Both sources must be unique earlier enabled Steps, must have passed, and must publish the required feature kind in the exact same coordinate layer and image size as this Step.
This Step never detects image edges, guesses coordinate transforms, moves an ROI, or converts pixels to physical units.

tools.role: Publish one pixel-space fixture origin and X axis from two exact earlier accepted Line Segment results.
validationHints: Use only after the operator identifies two distinct durable physical datum edges and explicitly selects their earlier Line/Segment identities.
Datum A defines the fixture X axis; both sources must be earlier accepted Segment results in the same coordinate layer and image size.
v1 scale is exactly one. Do not claim scale, perspective, calibration, homography, automatic physical identity, or field qualification.
Review exact Datum A/B, intersection, fixture axes, support, residual, included angle, and extension drawings after explicit Run.

tools.role: Rotate and/or resize an image layer.
validationHints: ScaleXPercent and ScaleYPercent must be positive for fixed RotateScale mode.
When USE_FIXTURE_FRAME=true and FIXTURE_APPLY_MODE=NormalizeImage, the runtime ignores fixed Angle/Scale values and uses the inverse pose from the named earlier Matching fixture.

NormalizeImage must branch from the same full source layer as Matching, requires ALLOW_BRANCH_INPUT=true, and rejects ROI/masks, missing dimensions, invalid pose/scale, source-size mismatch, and insufficient valid pixels.

tools.role: Apply a deterministic three-point 2D affine image mapping in pixel coordinates.
validationHints: Missing USE_DETECTED_SOURCE_POINTS preserves fixed numeric source points. When it is true, all three SOURCE_POINT_n_FEATURE values must name distinct accepted typed Point results from earlier enabled Steps on the same input layer and image frame.

Matching publishes Center only when exactly one usable match exists; ambiguous, missing, failed, wrong-kind, cross-frame, non-finite, and out-of-image Point sources fail closed without using stale numeric coordinates.
Source and destination points must be finite, ordered correspondences, and non-collinear even when a configured minimum triangle area is zero.
OutputWidth and OutputHeight use 0 to keep the corresponding input dimension; positive values are limited to 32768.
Review the destination triangle, transformed source frame, six matrix coefficients, and AffineValidPixelRatio after explicit Preview or Run.
This is a pixel-only affine mapping, not perspective correction, lens calibration, automatic correspondence, or calibrated metrology.

tools.role: Combine, compare, invert, or offset image layers.
validationHints: ArithmeticMode must be Operation or Offset.
ArithmeticOperation supports Bitwise_AND, Bitwise_OR, Bitwise_XOR, Bitwise_NOT, ADD, SUBTRACT, MULTIPLY, DIVIDE, MAX, MIN, ABS, ABSDIFF.
Operation mode requires InputLayerB unless the operation is Bitwise_NOT or ABS, or UseConstantInput is true.
InputLayerB must already exist before this Step.
Gray, B, G, and R are 0..255.

tools.role: Register an input against approved Good references and detect localized absolute-difference regions.
validationHints: ReferencePath1 is required; ReferencePath2 through ReferencePath4 are optional approved Good references.
Reference paths must point to existing image files so import can copy each dependency into the recipe Template folder.
DifferenceThreshold is 0..255, MinimumDefectArea must not exceed MaximumDefectArea, and MorphologyKernel must be odd and positive.
Use ResultCount minimum=0 and maximum=0 when zero detected difference regions is the OK condition.
Tune from labelled Train evidence and verify on held-out Validation/Test data; reference comparison is not automatic field qualification.

tools.role: Merge previous Step overlays into one operator review result image.
validationHints: SourceLayers is a semicolon-separated list of previous output layer names.
SourceSteps is a semicolon-separated list of previous Step names.
At least one source filter is preferred.
Put OverlayMerge last when it is the final review image.
